title: 第十九章 有元人的修仙路就是这么朴实无华第二十章 败家大神通专为氪金佬打造
slug: 看守废丹房三年我偷偷成仙了
lines: “此木剑名为春雷剑，乃雷击灵木打造，一剑斩出，如施雷法，筑基中期都不敢正面抵挡。”
“此石剑为泰岳剑，乃后土石精打造，攻防一体，可砸人斩人，又可为盾。”
陈元如数家珍，对秦凡仔细介绍，每讲一把剑，都让秦凡心动一次，目光愈发灼热。
讲句实话，这两把剑，他是真的喜欢啊……
可还是那句话，要想砍价，必须要不动声色，绝对不能让对方察觉自己的想法。
因此，秦凡始终表现平静，待介绍完毕后，先沉吟稍许，过了会儿才再度开口：
“陈管事，我能试一试这三把剑吗？”
“可以，只不过，以道友的修为，若要催动中品灵剑，可能会有些吃力，道友莫要伤到自己。”
“嗯，我知道。”
有了陈元的应允，秦凡深吸口气，佯装施展全力，先握住了春雷剑。
注入灵力，剑身瞬间颤动，雷光大绽，那凌厉的威势十分惊人。
好剑！
秦凡心下大赞，紧接着又接连试了绿蛟子母剑与泰岳剑，每一把剑都很是不凡。
秉着来都来了的原则，秦凡最终决定将这三把剑都收入囊中。
小孩子才做选择，他这个大人，他全都要了……
只是买东西也讲究买法，不光不能让人知晓你的喜好，也不能让人知道你的身家。
于是，试验结束之后，秦凡脸上露出了为难之色。
陈元见状，不由得好奇问道：“道友可还有什么问题？”
秦凡犹豫了一下，道：“敢问陈管事，这三把灵剑，都是何价格？”
陈元顿时恍然，旋即轻笑了笑道：“绿蛟子母剑要五万下品灵石，春雷剑和泰岳剑皆是四万下品灵石。”
“说句实在话，这个价格，已经是我能给王道友的最低价格了。”
五万加上两个四万，那就是十三万灵石，如此多的灵石，秦凡肯定是拿不出来。
可他本就没想用灵石，毕竟，用灵石哪有用丹药方便。
一枚筑基丹在拍卖会上的价格，一般是四五万灵石，那三枚筑基丹就是十二万到十五万。
要买下这三把灵剑，有三枚筑基丹便够了。
一番盘算，秦凡心下已然有数，于是只先拿出一颗筑基丹，对陈元问道：“这一颗筑基丹，不知陈管事觉得价值几何？”
“筑基丹？”
陈元神色微动，将丹药接过来，待看了一眼之后，顿时有些惊讶的道：“这竟是极品筑基丹，这可是个好东西啊。”
他抬头对秦凡问道：“此丹不知王道友是从何得来？”
“意外所得，敢问陈管事可估价几何？”
陈元啧啧称奇道：“这一枚筑基丹若放在拍卖会上，至少价值五万下品灵石。”
“五万？陈管事确定？”秦凡眉头轻动，对陈元问道。
“王道友觉得少了？那，不然我再加五千？”陈元犹豫道。
“可以，那便这么定了。”
秦凡轻轻一笑，旋即又拿出两枚筑基丹，“一枚五万五，三枚便是十六万五，这三把灵剑我都要了，然后陈管事再找我三万五千块下品灵石。”
从多宝楼出来，秦凡腰板比进去之前更挺更硬了，走路都带风，没办法，就是财大气粗。
content_en:
"This wooden sword is called the Spring Thunder Sword. It is made from the spirit wood struck by lightning. It is like casting a thunder spell with one strike. Even in the middle stage of foundation building, you don't dare to resist it head-on."
"This stone sword is the Taiyue Sword, made from fine earth and stone. It integrates offense and defense. It can hit and kill people, and it can also be used as a shield."
Chen Yuanru introduced his family treasures to Qin Fan in detail. Every time he talked about a sword, Qin Fan's heart skipped a beat, and his eyes became more intense.
To be honest, he really likes these two swords...
But again, if you want to bargain, you must stay calm and never let the other party notice your thoughts.
Therefore, Qin Fan always acted calmly. After the introduction, he pondered for a while and then spoke again after a while:
"Manager Chen, can I try these three swords?"
"Yes, but with my fellow Taoist's cultivation, it may be difficult to activate the middle-grade spiritual sword. Fellow Taoist, please don't hurt yourself."
"Yeah, I know."
With Chen Yuan's consent, Qin Fan took a deep breath, pretended to exert all his strength, and first grasped the Spring Thunder Sword.
Injecting spiritual power, the sword instantly trembled, and the lightning exploded. The fierce power was astonishing.
What a sword!
Qin Fan was greatly impressed, and then tried the Green Dragon Mother Sword and the Taiyue Sword one after another. Each sword was extraordinary.
Adhering to the principle of "whatever comes, come what comes", Qin Fan finally decided to keep all three swords in his bag.
Only children make choices. As an adult, he wants them all...
When buying things, you also need to pay attention to how you buy them. Not only can you not let others know your preferences, but you can also prevent others from knowing your net worth.
So, after the test was over, Qin Fan showed a look of embarrassment on his face.
When Chen Yuan saw this, he couldn't help but asked curiously: "Do you have any other questions, fellow Taoist?"
Qin Fan hesitated for a moment and said, "May I ask Manager Chen, what are the prices of these three spiritual swords?"
Chen Yuan suddenly understood, and then chuckled and said: "The Green Dragon Mother Sword costs 50,000 low-grade spiritual stones, and the Chunlei Sword and Taiyue Sword both cost 40,000 low-grade spiritual stones."
"To be honest, this price is already the lowest price I can give Wang Daoyou."
Fifty thousand plus two forty thousand, that is 130,000 spirit stones. Qin Fan will definitely not be able to get such many spirit stones.
But he didn't want to use spirit stones. After all, using spirit stones would not be as convenient as elixirs.
The price of one Foundation Establishment Pill at auction is usually 40,000 to 50,000 spirit stones, and the price of three Foundation Establishment Pills is 120,000 to 150,000.
To buy these three spiritual swords, three Foundation Establishment Pills are enough.
After some calculations, Qin Fan already knew it, so he took out a Foundation Establishment Pill first and asked Chen Yuan, "How much does Manager Chen think this Foundation Establishment Pill is worth?"
"Foundation Pill?"
Chen Yuan's expression moved slightly, and he took the elixir. After taking a look, he suddenly said with some surprise: "This is actually the best foundation-building elixir. This is a good thing."
He raised his head and asked Qin Fan: "I wonder where Wang Daoyou got this pill?"
"The unexpected income, may I ask Manager Chen how much it is worth?"
Chen Yuan clicked his tongue and said in wonder: "If this Foundation Building Pill were placed at auction, it would be worth at least 50,000 low-grade spiritual stones."
"Fifty thousand? Are you sure, Manager Chen?" Qin Fan raised his brows and asked Chen Yuan.
"Wang Daoyou thinks it's less? Then, how about I add another five thousand?" Chen Yuan hesitated.
"Okay, that's settled then."
Qin Fan smiled softly, and immediately took out two more Foundation Establishment Pills, "One is fifty-five thousand, three is one hundred and sixty-five thousand. I want these three spiritual swords, and then Manager Chen will ask me for thirty-five thousand low-grade spiritual stones."
Chen Yuan: "..."
…
Coming out of Duobao Building, Qin Fan's waist was straighter and stiffer than before he went in. He felt windy when he walked. There was nothing he could do about it, he just had a lot of money.
